section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: By accessing and using the FitCounter application, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use.

section2.title: 2. Disclaimer of Liability
section2.content: FitCounter is provided "as is" without any warranties. We are not responsible for any damages, health issues, or data loss resulting from the use of this application. Use it at your own risk.

section3.title: 3. Data Storage
section3.content: All data is stored locally on your device. We do not transmit, store, or process your personal data on external servers.

section4.title: 4. Dispute Resolution
section4.content: Any disputes arising from the use of this application shall be resolved exclusively by the competent courts in Gdańsk, Poland.

section5.title: 5. Changes to Terms
section5.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the application constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

section1.title: 1. Data Collection
section1.content: FitCounter does not collect, transmit, or share any personal information. The application operates entirely offline.

section2.title: 2. Local Storage
section2.content: All workout logs, goals, and settings are stored locally in your device's memory (IndexedDB/LocalStorage). You have full control over your data.

section3.title: 3. No Third-Party Sharing
section3.content: Since we do not collect data, we do not share any data with third parties, advertisers, or analytics providers.

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.content: Your data remains on your device. We recommend securing your device with a passcode or biometrics to protect your information.

section5.title: 5. Contact
section5.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us.
